label: Bible Study
prompt: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very _____. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verse: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
note: Day six ends with the Creator's review: not just good this time, but very good.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Yet now be _____, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
verse: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
note: Three 'be strong's for a discouraged rebuilding crew — the second Temple looked small, but God said 'I am with you.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not _____, but believing.
verse: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
note: The origin of 'doubting Thomas' — though the word Jesus actually uses in the KJV is faithless.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he is before all things, and by him all things _____.
verse: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
note: 'Consist' here means hold together — Paul says the glue of the universe has a name.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Preach the word; be _____ in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verse: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
note: 'Be instant in season, out of season' — 'instant' meaning urgent and ready. An ordination-service favorite.
